name: Mood
description: Hears how a voice sounds: neutral, happy, angry, sad (from the sound, not the words). Each spoken line gets a mood; the Companion and the answering model see it when it is clear ("voice #8, sounds happy"). Needs a mood model in the voice pool (the AAC senses service). A hint, not a verdict: it is often wrong.

threshold.title: Tell the model from (percent sure)
threshold.help: Moods below this are only shown in the buffer. Neutral is never passed on.

min_seconds.title: Shortest line (seconds)
min_seconds.help: Very short lines say little about a mood.

setup.title: Add a mood model
setup.hint: Run the AAC senses service (services/aac_senses in the AAC repository) on a machine, add it under Compute and put it into the voice pool's Mood role.
